question: Under what condition should the teacher bestow the teaching for long-lasting benefit?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
This examination should always be done
Only then should the gift be given
inference: The teacher should give the teaching only after always examining the recipient well.
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam may mean long life or a long-lasting transmission.
The fused token dadyāccirajīvitam is analyzed without splitting.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give it so that it endures long.
